panels.gesture: Open mouth in sharp short battle call, furrowed brows; two hands guide one shaft into a diagonal downward thrust beside torso, no overhead axe-like chop.
Small purposeful one-sided smirk and intent eyes; two spaced hands retract single trident near one flank, prongs angled outward in a feint, torso slightly turned.
Teeth slightly clenched with exertion; forward hand extends on shaft, rear hand drives from near hip, trident aimed obliquely offscreen, head not in front of face.
Eyes briefly widen and lips part, reacting without panic; two hands bring one continuous shaft into diagonal guard at chest level beside face.
Eyes narrowed, teeth gritted; both hands braced a forearm apart on one shaft angled low and outward, shoulders absorb imaginary pressure.
One brow knit more strongly, lips thin, eyes tracking sideways; two hands hold trident aimed out laterally as a cautious intercepting guard.
One raised brow, slight doubtful closed-mouth tilt; trident resting upright in one gloved hand, free hand on hip, no aggressive movement.
Very small reassuring smile and soft direct eyes; trident at relaxed diagonal carry in both hands, shoulders level.
Eyes lowered briefly, controlled half-open exhale, no grimace; trident upright in one hand with other hand lightly supporting lower shaft, a composed neutral pause.
